training_rounds.lesson: Ground truth is earned by direct localized observation and measurement, not inferred from resemblance.

provenance_discrepancy_preserved.observation_A: A 2023 AGU mapping abstract describes six clusters of chimneys at Puy des Folles.
provenance_discrepancy_preserved.observation_B: Schmidt Ocean Institute expedition summaries describe five active sites across about 18 square kilometres.
provenance_discrepancy_preserved.interpretation: Cluster count and active-site count need not denote the same unit. Do not silently force equality or call a contradiction without source-definition reconciliation.

discipline_score.meaning: Evidence-handling tests only; not predictive accuracy, sensitivity, specificity or vent-detection performance.

what_topa_learned: A map can show a candidate but cannot prove the process is active.
Chemical and optical plume signals can prove an active hydrothermal process is nearby without fixing the vent mouth.
Independent modalities should multiply confidence only when their physical dependencies are understood.
Faults, pits, scarps, talus and volcanic relief are strong morphology confounders.
The expected hypothesis must not censor an unexpected ordinary physical explanation or a different real phenomenon.
Negative objectives survive adjacent positive discoveries.
Ground-truth labels do not license reconstruction of evidence that was not actually retrieved.

independent second-site replication plus source-localizing behavior inconsistent with RFI/instrument models
